items.title: 時隔15年重返伺服器市場！蘋果擬推M8 Ultra並考慮引入輝達互聯技術 大行激辯蘋果AI算力野心
items.title_en: Returning to the Server Market After 15 Years! Apple Plans M8 Ultra and Considers NVIDIA Interconnect Technology; Major Banks Debate Apple’s AI Compute Ambitions
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，蘋果正評估進軍企業級AI伺服器市場，打算以自研M系列Ultra晶片為核心，搭配輝達網絡設備，面向AI開發者、企業與政府客戶銷售本地推理整機，產品最快2029年面世，但仍可能取消，也不排除最終不用輝達方案。
美國科技媒體《The Information》引述知情人士報導，蘋果AI伺服器方案分為兩檔：低配整合兩顆尚未發布的M8 Ultra，高配四顆M8 Ultra組成運算集群；多晶片互聯正與輝達洽談採用NVLink Fusion，包含交換器、晶粒與配套軟體，以解決機架內高速協同。
這是蘋果自Xserve停產後再度試探專用伺服器。Xserve於2002年前後起步、先後採用PowerPC與英特爾至強，2010年蘋果宣布停止後續研發，2011年1月停售，改以Mac Pro、Mac mini Server替代。當時，賈伯斯對用戶郵件稱「幾乎沒有人購買」，企業支持、軟體生態與戴爾/IBM等通用伺服器差距是主要弱點。
如今情況有所不同。蘋果2026財年第三財季Mac營收年增29%至103億美元，OpenAI等實驗室採購數萬台Mac mini、Mac Studio用於強化學習訓練智能體，Anthropic亦透過AWS租用Mac mini，部分機型一度缺貨，使蘋果把「端側晶片能力」外溢到資料中心有了需求基礎。
M8 Ultra若沿用蘋果統一記憶體與高能源效率架構，更適合大模型推理、隱私敏感型本地部署，而非與輝達GPU集群正面對拼訓練。但多顆Ultra對蘋果來說，採用NVLink可補齊超大規模部署的互聯弱點，代價則是互聯標準取捨。
蘋果是UALink聯盟董事會成員，該組織由AMD、英特爾、谷歌、微軟等推動開放標準，成員已超65家，若最終倒向NVLink專有方案，將在「開放可移植」與「效能訊號傳遞快」之間釋放出明確訊號。
市場空間夠大但競爭已紅海。根據高盛預估，全球AI伺服器市場2030年達1.24兆美元，2025-2030年複合成長率(CAGR)約45%；戴爾、HPE、超微等已跑出規模：按用戶提供數據，戴爾最近財季營收469. 7億美元、年增57.8%，單季AI伺服器訂單609億美元、期末積壓訂單950億美元；HPE營收122.1億美元、年增32.7%；超微111.2億美元、年增93.2%。
專家指出，蘋果差異化不靠低價整機，而靠私有化、統一記憶體、能效與隱私合規切入金融、醫療、政務等公有雲場景，若能以溢價賣出「差異化推理節點」，才有望避開與通用x86服務器拼毛利。

但風險同樣清晰，伺服器是低毛利、重交付、重生命週期服務的B2B生意，與蘋果消費電子高毛利模式不同。當年，Xserve折戟的企業級遠端管理、合規認證、保固與軟體工具仍是弱點。自研互聯Private Cloud Compute在超大規模下存在成本與頻寬瓶頸，正是外購NVLink的動因，但也會提高BOM與對輝達依賴。記憶體晶片短缺、M8 Ultra量產節奏、MLX框架相對CUDA生態差距、核心人才流失，都可能影響2029年產品落地。
若蘋果新執行長特納斯任內把Mac晶片能力延伸到機架，則蘋果AI敘事從設備端邁向企業端，但能否補齊Xserve時代缺的企業級能力，才是2029年能否真正重返伺服器的關鍵。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Apple is evaluating entry into the enterprise‑grade AI server market, planning to base the offering on its in‑house M‑series Ultra chips combined with NVIDIA networking gear. The goal is to sell complete inference machines to AI developers, enterprises and government customers, with the earliest shipments slated for 2029, though the project could still be cancelled and Apple may ultimately forego NVIDIA solutions.

The Information, citing insiders, says Apple’s AI server lineup will have two tiers: a low‑end model integrating two as‑yet‑unreleased M8 Ultra chips, and a high‑end model that clusters four M8 Ultra chips. Apple is negotiating with NVIDIA to use NVLink Fusion for multi‑chip interconnect, which would include switches, silicon‑interposers and accompanying software to enable high‑speed rack‑level coordination.

This would be Apple’s first foray into dedicated servers since the Xserve was discontinued. The Xserve debuted around 2002, initially using PowerPC and later Intel Xeon processors. Apple announced the end of its development in 2010 and stopped sales in January 2011, replacing it with the Mac Pro and Mac mini Server. At the time, Steve Jobs told customers by email that “hardly anyone bought them,” citing weak enterprise support, a thin software ecosystem, and competition from generic servers from Dell, IBM and others as the main drawbacks.

The situation is different today. In Apple’s fiscal 2026 third quarter, Mac revenue grew 29% year‑over‑year to $10.3 billion. Labs such as OpenAI have purchased tens of thousands of Mac mini and Mac Studio units for reinforcement‑learning training of agents, and Anthropic rents Mac mini instances on AWS. Some models even ran out of stock, giving Apple a foothold for extending its “edge‑chip capabilities” into data‑center workloads.

If the M8 Ultra retains Apple’s unified memory architecture and high energy‑efficiency design, it would be better suited for large‑model inference and privacy‑sensitive on‑prem deployments rather than competing head‑to‑head with NVIDIA GPU clusters for training. Using multiple Ultra chips linked by NVLink would help Apple overcome interconnect limitations in massive deployments, though it would involve trade‑offs around the choice of interconnect standards.

Apple sits on the board of the UALink Alliance, an industry group driven by AMD, Intel, Google, Microsoft and others to promote open interconnect standards. The alliance now has more than 65 members. If Apple ultimately backs NVIDIA’s proprietary NVLink instead, it would send a clear signal about its preference between “open, portable” solutions and “high‑performance, low‑latency” signaling.

The market opportunity is huge but already a red‑sea. Goldman Sachs estimates the global AI server market will reach $1.24 trillion by 2030, with a CAGR of roughly 45% from 2025‑2030. Dell, HPE, and AMD’s (formerly Supermicro) businesses have already scaled: Dell reported $46.97 billion in revenue for the latest quarter, up 57.8% YoY, with $60.9 billion in AI‑server orders and $95 billion in backlog; HPE posted $12.21 billion, up 32.7%; AMD’s server segment generated $11.12 billion, up 93.2%.

Experts say Apple’s differentiation will not come from low‑priced hardware but from a private, unified‑memory, energy‑efficient and privacy‑compliant stack aimed at financial, healthcare and government cloud scenarios. If Apple can sell “differentiated inference nodes” at a premium, it may avoid margin battles with commodity x86 servers.

The risks are equally clear: servers are a low‑margin, delivery‑intensive, lifecycle‑service B2B business, unlike Apple’s high‑margin consumer electronics model. The Xserve’s failure was due in part to weak enterprise remote‑management, compliance certifications, warranty and software tooling. Building a private‑cloud interconnect at massive scale brings cost and bandwidth bottlenecks, which is why buying NVLink is attractive—but it also raises BOM costs and dependence on NVIDIA. Chip‑level memory shortages, the production ramp of the M8 Ultra, the relative immaturity of the MLX framework versus CUDA, and talent attrition could all delay a 2029 launch.

If Apple’s new CEO Tim Cook (or the article’s referenced “Turner”) extends Mac‑chip capabilities to rack form factors, Apple’s AI narrative would shift from edge devices to the enterprise. Whether Apple can fill the enterprise‑grade gaps that plagued the Xserve era will determine if it can truly return to the server market in 2029.

items.title: Fed升息後 戴蒙：還不能確定通膨已被擊敗
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hikes: Dimon Says It’s Still Unclear If Inflation Has Been Defeated
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)周三(16日)表示，在聯準會(Fed)升息並暗示借貸成本可能再次上升後，他仍不確定高通膨問題是否已經被解決。
戴蒙談到，「我能理解那些必須支付更高價格的人，但我還不確定事情已經結束。我還不確定我們已經擊敗了通膨。」
聯準會升息25個基點，政策制定者預測2026年至少還會再升息一次後，美股走低。同時，長天期公債殖利率上升，本周10年期公債殖利率再次突破5%。
這位全美最大銀行的長期掌舵者多年來一直警告，通膨可能比投資人預期的更加頑強。他在4月的股東信中更形容通膨是「派對上的臭鼬」(skunk at the party)。
美國8月整體通膨率達到3.4%，戴蒙表示，「每一家企業都應該為利率波動做好準備」，這也呼應了他過去曾發表的相關看法。
戴蒙指出，持續性的通膨、全球財政赤字，以及龐大的資本需求，包括AI、重新軍備以及其他基礎建設擴張，都可能持續對利率形成上行壓力。
儘管有所擔憂，戴蒙並未暗示經濟即將陷入衰退，並指出低失業率、企業獲利能力，以及企業新成立數量增加，都是經濟持續保持強勁的證據。
他談到，「目前有很多事情相當危險。而這些事情最後會如何發展，我不知道。」
他認為，勞動市場仍是判斷這些風險是否正在轉化為更廣泛經濟壓力的最重要指標。「當失業率開始上升時，就會出現消費者信貸損失、企業信貸損失，人們也會削減支出。這是對每個人而言最重要的一件事。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon said on Wednesday (the 16th) that after the Federal Reserve raised rates and hinted borrowing costs could rise again, he is still not sure whether the high‑inflation problem has been solved.
Dimon said, “I can understand those who have to pay higher prices, but I’m still not certain the story is over. I’m not sure we have beaten inflation yet.”

The Fed lifted rates by 25 basis points, and policymakers project at least one more hike by 2026, sending U.S. equities lower. At the same time, long‑term Treasury yields rose, with the 10‑year yield breaking above 5% again this week.

The long‑time head of the nation’s biggest bank has warned for years that inflation could be more stubborn than investors expect. In his April shareholder letter he even described inflation as a “skunk at the party.”
U.S. headline inflation hit 3.4% in August, and Dimon said, “Every company should be prepared for rate volatility,” echoing his earlier remarks on the issue.
Dimon noted that persistent inflation, global fiscal deficits, and massive capital needs—including AI, re‑armament and other infrastructure expansion—could keep upward pressure on rates.

Despite the concerns, Dimon did not suggest a recession is imminent, pointing to low unemployment, corporate profitability and a rise in new business formations as evidence the economy remains strong.
He said, “There are a lot of things that are quite dangerous right now. How those things will ultimately play out, I don’t know.”

He believes the labor market remains the most important gauge for judging whether these risks are turning into broader economic pressure. “When unemployment starts to rise, you’ll see consumer‑credit losses, corporate‑credit losses, and people will cut back spending. That’s the most important thing for everyone.”

items.title: 美軍證實部署太空軌道武器 還要準備月球周邊作戰
items.title_en: U.S. Confirms Deployment of Space Orbit Weapons, Prepares for Lunar Operations
paras: 美國軍方最高軍事顧問周三表示，美軍不僅需要準備在地球軌道作戰，也必須為月球周邊的戰鬥做好準備。此番談話凸顯美國正將太空視為未來戰爭的新前線，而美國近期也首度證實已在太空部署武器。
美軍參謀首長聯席會議主席凱恩（Dan Caine）上將在華盛頓郊外舉行的空軍、太空與網路安全會議上，向軍方人員與產業界人士表示，美軍應立即調整，以確保「能夠從海底一路延伸至地月空間，做好戰鬥、承受壓力並取得勝利的準備」。
所謂「地月空間」（cislunar space），是指地球表面與月球之間的區域。
美國太空軍是川普於2019年成立的最新軍種，目前正準備在太空及月球周邊執行作戰任務。太空軍作戰部隊司令岡農（Gregory Gagnon）中將另對媒體表示，隨著「人類正逐步深入太空」，太空軍的任務就是協助美國做好防衛自身利益的準備。
美軍宣布準備在地球高軌道與月球之間區域作戰的消息，距離空軍部長梅因克（Troy Meink）在同一場會議上透露，美軍已部署「軌道太空控制武器」（on-orbit space control weapons），僅相隔數日。
近幾日美國軍方高層陸續釋出太空武器相關訊息，與長期以來將外太空視為僅供和平用途、避免軍事化的國際共識形成對比。
美國警告對手可能將太空變成戰場
包括美國在內，多個國家過去已展示從地面擊落地球軌道衛星的能力，但相關測試都是以地面武器攻擊自身衛星為主。
岡農表示，美國情報界已明確指出，潛在對手正試圖將戰爭延伸至太空，因此美軍必須做出因應。
他表示：「包括中國在內的潛在對手，正積極在太空體系及相關區域展開活動。」其中，中國在2024年成立自身的軍事太空部隊，負責提升處理太空危機的能力。
對於美國宣布部署太空武器，中國外交部發言人郭嘉昆周二表示，中國始終堅持和平利用外太空，維護太空安全，反對外太空武器化、軍事化以及太空軍備競賽。
郭嘉昆也呼籲美國「停止擴大在外太空的軍事準備」。
目前尚不清楚，美國部署太空武器，或未來可能在月球周邊使用相關武器的計畫，是否會違反限制太空軍事化的國際條約。
1967年生效的《外太空條約》（Outer Space Treaty），美國與中國均為簽署國。條約規定，包括月球在內的天體應「專門用於和平目的」，禁止在太空部署核武器，並要求各國須對其太空物體造成的損害承擔責任。
兩年前，美國指控俄羅斯正在研發太空武器後，聯合國內部也再度出現推動強化太空非軍事化措施的呼聲。
岡農表示，美國計畫在未來5年內將太空軍規模擴增一倍，達約2.5萬名軍人，其中約三分之二的新增人力將投入作戰部隊司令部。
paras_en: The U.S. top military adviser said on Wednesday that the U.S. military must not only prepare for operations in Earth orbit but also be ready for combat around the Moon, underscoring the U.S. view of space as a new front in future warfare and confirming for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space.

General Dan Caine, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, told military personnel and industry at an Air Force, Space, and Cyber Security conference outside Washington that the U.S. must adjust immediately to ensure it can "extend from the ocean floor to the Earth‑Moon space, be ready for combat, withstand pressure, and achieve victory."
The so‑called "cislunar space" refers to the region between the Earth's surface and the Moon.

The U.S. Space Force, created by Trump in 2019, is now preparing to conduct operations in space and around the Moon. Space Force combat commander Gregory Gagnon told the media that as humanity gradually ventures deeper into space, the Space Force's mission is to help the U.S. defend its interests.

The announcement that the U.S. is preparing to operate between Earth’s high orbit and the Moon came just days after Air Force Secretary Troy Meinke revealed at the same conference that the U.S. has deployed "on‑orbit space control weapons."

In recent days, U.S. senior officials have released information about space weapons, contrasting with the long‑standing international consensus that outer space should be used only for peaceful purposes and kept free of militarization.
The United States warns that adversaries may turn space into a battlefield.

Several countries, including the U.S., have previously demonstrated the ability to shoot down Earth‑orbiting satellites from the ground, but those tests have focused on attacking their own satellites with ground weapons.
Gagnon said U.S. intelligence has clearly indicated that potential adversaries are trying to extend warfare into space, so the U.S. must respond.

He added that potential adversaries, including China, are actively conducting activities in the space system and related areas. China established its own military space force in 2024 to enhance its ability to handle space crises.

Regarding the U.S. announcement of deploying space weapons, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said on Tuesday that China remains committed to the peaceful use of outer space, the protection of space security, and opposes the weaponization, militarization, and arms race in outer space.
Guo also urged the U.S. to "stop expanding its military preparations in outer space."
It is still unclear whether the U.S. deployment of space weapons, or future plans to use such weapons around the Moon, would violate international treaties that limit the militarization of space.

The Outer Space Treaty, effective since 1967, is signed by both the U.S. and China. The treaty stipulates that celestial bodies, including the Moon, are to be used exclusively for peaceful purposes, prohibits the deployment of nuclear weapons in space, and requires states to be responsible for damage caused by their space objects.
Two years ago, after the U.S. accused Russia of developing space weapons, the United Nations again called for strengthening non‑militarization measures in space.
Gagnon said the U.S. plans to double the size of the Space Force over the next five years to about 25,000 personnel, with roughly two‑thirds of the new manpower going to combat command units.

items.title: 全球大型銅礦Grasberg恢復供料2027年迎產量正常化
items.title_en: Global Giant Copper Mine Grasberg Resumes Supply, Production Normalization Expected in 2027
paras: 2026年09月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球大型銅礦Grasberg供應逐步恢復。這座印尼重要銅金礦過去曾是全球第二大露天銅礦，供應變化足以牽動全球銅市。目前PT Freeport Indonesia已恢復向Manyar冶煉廠供應銅精礦，帶動8月恢復進料、9月重啟生產；隨礦區分階段復產，整體產出預計2027年進一步正常化。
Manyar先前因Grasberg原料不足一度停產。2025年9月Grasberg Block Cave地下礦區發生泥流事故，約80萬噸濕物質湧入礦區，造成採礦活動中斷。由於事故後有限的銅精礦優先供應PT Smelting，Manyar因此缺乏足夠原料維持生產。
目前供應鏈開始恢復。Freeport-McMoRan(FCX-US)規劃於2026年分階段重啟Grasberg Block Cave的Production Blocks 2與3，Production Block 1則預計2027年恢復，意味上游銅礦供應仍需要一段時間才能完全正常化。
Manyar冶煉廠則已率先進入產量爬坡階段。公司9月銅陰極產量目標約500萬磅，10月預計提高至3,500萬磅、11月5,500萬磅，12月進一步增至5,700萬磅，顯示隨Grasberg精礦重新流入，冶煉端產量正在快速恢復。
Manyar是印尼推動銅產業下游化的重要投資，總投資約42億美元，每年可處理170萬噸銅精礦，設計年產能達60萬噸銅陰極及150萬噸硫酸。這也意味Grasberg復產不只影響全球銅礦供給，更直接決定印尼新增精煉銅產能能否充分利用。
不過，2026年仍屬復產過渡期。Freeport預估Grasberg今年銅產量約10億磅、黃金約90萬盎司，較事故前預期低約35%。相關產量預測則顯示，印尼2026年銅礦產量約765,080噸，年增率僅1%，2027年隨Grasberg進一步恢復，產量預估增至1,032,850噸，年增率35%。

paras_en: September 17, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Supply from the world’s large copper mine Grasberg is gradually recovering. The Indonesian copper‑gold mine, once the second‑largest open‑pit copper mine globally, can move the worldwide copper market with its supply changes. PT Freeport Indonesia has now resumed feeding copper concentrate to the Manyar smelter, prompting material intake to restart in August and production to resume in September; as the mine phases back into operation, overall output is expected to further normalize in 2027.

Manyar had previously halted operations due to a shortage of raw material from Grasberg. In September 2025 a mudflow incident struck the Grasberg Block Cave underground mine, sending about 800,000 tonnes of wet material into the mine and halting mining activities. Because the limited copper concentrate after the accident was given priority to PT Smelting, Manyar lacked sufficient feedstock to keep running.

The supply chain is now beginning to recover. Freeport‑McMoRan (FCX‑US) plans to restart Grasberg Block Cave’s Production Blocks 2 and 3 in stages during 2026, while Production Block 1 is slated to come back online in 2027, meaning upstream copper supply will still need time to return to full normality.

Manyar’s smelter has already entered a production‑ramp‑up phase. The company targets about 5 million pounds of copper cathode in September, 35 million pounds in October, 55 million pounds in November and 57 million pounds in December, showing that as Grasberg concentrate flows back in, smelting output is recovering rapidly.

Manyar is a key downstream copper investment in Indonesia, with total investment of roughly US$4.2 billion. It can process 1.7 million tonnes of copper concentrate per year and is designed for an annual capacity of 600,000 tonnes of copper cathode and 1.5 million tonnes of sulfuric acid. This means Grasberg’s restart not only affects global copper ore supply but also directly determines whether Indonesia’s new refined‑copper capacity can be fully utilized.

However, 2026 remains a transition year for the restart. Freeport estimates Grasberg’s copper output this year at about 1 billion pounds and gold at roughly 900,000 ounces, about 35% lower than pre‑incident expectations. Related forecasts show Indonesia’s copper mine production in 2026 at about 765,080 tonnes, a modest 1% year‑over‑year increase, rising to an estimated 1,032,850 tonnes in 2027 as Grasberg further recovers – a 35% annual growth rate.

items.title: Meta自研AI晶片進入量產關鍵期未來12個月部署規模突破1GW
items.title_en: Meta’s In-House AI Chip Enters Key Production Phase, Future 12-Month Deployment to Exceed 1GW
paras: 2026年09月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Meta Platforms(META-US)自2023年起投入自研AI晶片，目前正測試第三代MTIA 450、代號「Arke」，預計2027年上半年開始部署；第四代MTIA 500、代號「Astrid」則預計2027年底逐步進駐資料中心。Meta並承諾未來12個月內部署總耗電規模超過1GW的自研AI晶片，顯示自研加速器正從測試階段走向大規模商業部署。
Meta與博通Broadcom(AVGO-US)合作設計MTIA，並委由台積電(2330-TW)生產，主要鎖定一般AI推論工作負載，以提高每瓦電力及每美元支出的運算效能，並降低對輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)高階AI處理器的依賴。四代MTIA均採用高頻寬記憶體（HBM），隨部署規模跨越1GW，也將同步擴大先進製程與HBM需求。
量產進度方面，台積電9月初已交付12顆新款晶片樣品，實測效能與Meta模擬結果僅相差2%至3%，且首批晶片已成功執行Meta自家模型，以及DeepSeek、阿里巴巴Alibaba(BABA-US)的AI模型。目前設計尚未發現明顯問題，後續仍需數月進行測試、調校及量產爬坡。
台灣IP供應鏈也直接參與其中。晶心科(6533-TW)為Meta重要客戶，Meta數代自研AI晶片均採用晶心科IP。隨MTIA從單顆驗證走向1GW級資料中心部署，相關需求將從晶片設計進一步轉向晶圓量產、HBM配置與資料中心實際建置，成為觀察Meta自研AI晶片商業化進度的重要指標。

All four generations of MTIA use high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), and as deployment scales beyond 1GW, the demand for advanced process nodes and HBM will also increase.

The Taiwanese IP supply chain is also directly involved. Chipmaker Chimei Electronics (6533-TW) is a key customer for Meta, and all of Meta’s in‑house AI chips have used Chimei’s IP. items.title: 日本干預匯市「抽血」？7月海外持美債降至九個月低谷
items.title_en: Japan’s Market Intervention 'Bloodletting'? Overseas Holdings of US Treasuries Drop to Nine‑Month Low in July
paras: 美國官方數據顯示，今年7月海外投資者的美國國債持倉規模降至九個月低谷，這一時間恰恰與美國最大海外債主日本干預匯市、支持日元的行動重合。
美國財政部16日（周三）公布的國際資本流動報告（TIC）顯示，7月海外投資者持有的美國國債規模連降兩個月，比6月減少504億美元，降至9.25兆美元，是2025年10月以來最低。
TIC報告顯示，法國和加拿大持倉下降是7月海外美債持倉回落的主要因素。日本、中國也繼續減持。
TIC報告顯示，日本7月持有的美國國債規模較6月減少128億美元，降至1.1039兆美元，連續兩個月寫2025年1月以來持倉新低，但總持倉仍是海外國家最多。
日本是美國國債最大海外持有國，其外儲配置與美債市場之間的聯繫一直受市場關注。近幾個月日本減持美債與其匯市干預在時間上重合。
日本財務省5月29日公布的數據顯示，4月28日至5月27日期間，日本的外匯市場干預總額達到11.73兆日元。分析人士認為，日本這類買入日元的交易很可能涉及一定規模的美國國債出售。
日本財務省8月3日證實，日本政府與美國財政部於7月31日協調實施買入日元匯率干預，以遏制日元匯率近期劇烈波動。
這是日美兩國自2011年東日本大地震後首次協調干預匯市，也是金融危機等特殊時期之外極為罕見的聯合行動。
日本財務省在8月29日公布的數據顯示，7月30日至8月26日期間，日本政府共計投入約15.4兆日元干預匯市，寫下干預金額新高。
干預匯市需要日方賣出外匯、買入日元。由於日本外儲中持有大量美國國債，市場因此關注，日本是否會通過出售美債等美元資產，為干預行動提供銀彈。
但需要注意，TIC報告統計的是持倉餘額變化，既包括實際買賣，也包括債券估值變化。因此，投資人不能僅憑這份報告確認日本為干預匯市出售了多少美債。
paras_en: U.S. official data shows that overseas investors’ holdings of U.S. Treasury securities fell to a nine‑month low in July, coinciding with Japan’s intervention in the foreign exchange market to support the yen.

On Wednesday, the U.S. Treasury released its International Capital Flow Report (TIC), indicating that overseas investors’ holdings of U.S. Treasuries declined for the second consecutive month in July, falling by $50.4 billion from June to $9.25 trillion, the lowest level since October 2025.
The TIC report attributes the decline in overseas U.S. Treasury holdings in July mainly to reductions by France and Canada, with Japan and China also continuing to sell.

The report shows that Japan’s holdings of U.S. Treasuries in July decreased by $12.8 billion from June to $1.1039 trillion, marking a new low for the country since January 2025, yet Japan remains the largest overseas holder overall.

Japan is the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries, and the link between its foreign‑reserve allocation and the Treasury market has long attracted market attention. In recent months, Japan’s Treasury sell‑offs have overlapped in timing with its FX interventions.

Data released by Japan’s Ministry of Finance on May 29 showed that from April 28 to May 27, Japan’s total foreign‑exchange market intervention reached ¥11.73 trillion. Analysts believe that these yen‑buying trades likely involved the sale of a significant amount of U.S. Treasuries.

On August 3, the Ministry of Finance confirmed that the Japanese government and the U.S. Treasury coordinated a yen‑buying intervention on July 31 to curb recent sharp volatility in the yen’s exchange rate.

This marks the first coordinated intervention between Japan and the United States since the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, and is a rare joint action outside of special periods such as financial crises.

Data released by the Ministry of Finance on August 29 showed that from July 30 to August 26, the Japanese government invested a total of about ¥15.4 trillion in FX interventions, setting a new high for intervention amounts.

FX interventions require Japan to sell foreign currency and buy yen. Because Japan holds large amounts of U.S. Treasuries in its foreign reserves, the market closely watches whether Japan will sell Treasury or other dollar assets to provide the 'silver bullet' for the intervention.

However, it should be noted that the TIC report records changes in net holdings, which include both actual trades and changes in bond valuations. Therefore, investors cannot rely solely on this report to determine how many U.S. Treasuries Japan sold to intervene in the market.

items.title: 聯準會睽違3年啟動升息循環通膨降溫延至2029年、今年還要再升
items.title_en: Fed Starts Rate‑Hike Cycle After 3‑Year Pause, Inflation Cooling Slows to 2029, More Hikes Likely This Year
paras: 2026年09月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國聯準會16日一致決議升息1碼，將聯邦基金利率目標區間提高至3.75%至4.00%，不僅是3年來首度升息，也是Kevin Warsh接任聯準會主席後首次調整貨幣政策。最新預測顯示，18名決策官員中有16人認為2026年底前至少還需再升息1碼，政策利率年底可能進一步升至4.00%至4.25%。
聯準會此次轉向緊縮，關鍵在於通膨壓力已不再被視為單純來自能源等一次性供給衝擊。Warsh表示，美國經濟與就業市場轉強，國內支出具韌性、生產力成長強勁，資本投資也維持熱絡，使價格壓力更為廣泛。聯準會因此在聲明中刪除先前將高通膨歸因於「供給衝擊」的說法。
最新經濟預測也顯示，聯準會對通膨回落速度轉趨保守。2026年個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數預估由6月的3.6%上修至3.7%，通膨回到2%目標的時間則延後至2029年，比先前預估晚1年。相較之下，2026年經濟成長率預估由2.2%上修至2.3%，年底失業率預估則由4.3%下修至4.1%，顯示經濟韌性也提供聯準會進一步升息的空間。
市場已迅速調整利率預期。根據CME FedWatch Tool，利率期貨反映2026年底前再升息1碼的機率約90%；聯準會最新預測則顯示，政策利率在2026年底及2027年底均落在4.00%至4.25%區間。政策聲明公布後，美元走強，美國2年期公債殖利率升至逾2年高點。
美國總統川普則再次公開要求大幅降息，主張美國利率應降至1%甚至更低，與聯準會目前政策方向形成明顯落差。Warsh則表示，目前廣泛金融環境很難稱為緊縮，因此此次政策行動是移除部分寬鬆程度，以加快通膨回到2%目標。

paras_en: On September 17, 2026, the U.S. Federal Reserve unanimously decided to raise rates by one basis point, lifting the federal funds target range to 3.75%–4.00%. This is the first rate hike in three years and the first policy adjustment under new Chair Kevin Warsh. The latest forecast shows that 16 of 18 policymakers expect at least one more hike before the end of 2026, potentially pushing the policy rate to 4.00%–4.25% by year‑end.

The Fed’s shift to tightening hinges on the view that inflationary pressure is no longer seen as merely a one‑off supply shock from energy. Warsh noted that the U.S. economy and labor market have strengthened, domestic spending is resilient, productivity growth is robust, and capital investment remains vigorous, making price pressure more widespread. Consequently, the Fed removed earlier language attributing high inflation to “supply shocks.”

The latest economic forecast also shows the Fed becoming more cautious about the pace of inflation decline. The 2026 Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index is now projected to rise from 3.6% in June to 3.7%, pushing the return to the 2% target to 2029—one year later than previously estimated. In contrast, the 2026 growth rate is raised from 2.2% to 2.3%, and the year‑end unemployment rate is lowered from 4.3% to 4.1%, indicating that economic resilience also leaves room for further hikes.

Markets have quickly adjusted rate expectations. According to the CME FedWatch Tool, the probability of another hike before the end of 2026 is about 90%. The Fed’s latest forecast shows the policy rate at 4.00%–4.25% both at the end of 2026 and 2027. After the policy statement, the dollar strengthened and the yield on the U.S. 2‑year Treasury rose to a more than two‑year high.

U.S. President Trump again publicly called for a steep rate cut, arguing that U.S. rates should fall to 1% or lower, creating a stark contrast with the Fed’s current policy direction. Warsh said that the current broad financial environment is not truly restrictive, so this policy action removes some looseness to accelerate inflation back to the 2% target.

items.title: 日本干預匯市「抽血」？7月海外持美債降至九個月低谷
items.title_en: Japan’s Market Intervention 'Bloodletting'? Overseas Holdings of US Treasuries Drop to Nine‑Month Low in July
paras: 美國官方數據顯示，今年7月海外投資者的美國國債持倉規模降至九個月低谷，這一時間恰恰與美國最大海外債主日本干預匯市、支持日元的行動重合。
美國財政部16日（周三）公布的國際資本流動報告（TIC）顯示，7月海外投資者持有的美國國債規模連降兩個月，比6月減少504億美元，降至9.25兆美元，是2025年10月以來最低。
TIC報告顯示，法國和加拿大持倉下降是7月海外美債持倉回落的主要因素。日本、中國也繼續減持。
TIC報告顯示，日本7月持有的美國國債規模較6月減少128億美元，降至1.1039兆美元，連續兩個月寫2025年1月以來持倉新低，但總持倉仍是海外國家最多。
日本是美國國債最大海外持有國，其外儲配置與美債市場之間的聯繫一直受市場關注。近幾個月日本減持美債與其匯市干預在時間上重合。
日本財務省5月29日公布的數據顯示，4月28日至5月27日期間，日本的外匯市場干預總額達到11.73兆日元。分析人士認為，日本這類買入日元的交易很可能涉及一定規模的美國國債出售。
日本財務省8月3日證實，日本政府與美國財政部於7月31日協調實施買入日元匯率干預，以遏制日元匯率近期劇烈波動。
這是日美兩國自2011年東日本大地震後首次協調干預匯市，也是金融危機等特殊時期之外極為罕見的聯合行動。
日本財務省在8月29日公布的數據顯示，7月30日至8月26日期間，日本政府共計投入約15.4兆日元干預匯市，寫下干預金額新高。
干預匯市需要日方賣出外匯、買入日元。由於日本外儲中持有大量美國國債，市場因此關注，日本是否會通過出售美債等美元資產，為干預行動提供銀彈。
但需要注意，TIC報告統計的是持倉餘額變化，既包括實際買賣，也包括債券估值變化。因此，投資人不能僅憑這份報告確認日本為干預匯市出售了多少美債。
paras_en: U.S. official data shows that overseas investors’ holdings of U.S. Treasury securities fell to a nine‑month low in July, coinciding with Japan’s intervention in the foreign exchange market to support the yen.

On Wednesday, the U.S. Treasury released its International Capital Flow Report (TIC), indicating that overseas investors’ holdings of U.S. Treasuries declined for the second consecutive month in July, falling by $50.4 billion from June to $9.25 trillion, the lowest level since October 2025.
The TIC report attributes the decline in overseas U.S. Treasury holdings in July mainly to reductions by France and Canada, with Japan and China also continuing to sell.

The report shows that Japan’s holdings of U.S. Treasuries in July decreased by $12.8 billion from June to $1.1039 trillion, marking a new low for the country since January 2025, yet Japan remains the largest overseas holder overall.

Japan is the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries, and the link between its foreign‑reserve allocation and the Treasury market has long attracted market attention. In recent months, Japan’s Treasury sell‑offs have overlapped in timing with its FX interventions.

Data released by Japan’s Ministry of Finance on May 29 showed that from April 28 to May 27, Japan’s total foreign‑exchange market intervention reached ¥11.73 trillion. Analysts believe that these yen‑buying trades likely involved the sale of a significant amount of U.S. Treasuries.

On August 3, the Ministry of Finance confirmed that the Japanese government and the U.S. Treasury coordinated a yen‑buying intervention on July 31 to curb recent sharp volatility in the yen’s exchange rate.

This marks the first coordinated intervention between Japan and the United States since the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, and is a rare joint action outside of special periods such as financial crises.

Data released by the Ministry of Finance on August 29 showed that from July 30 to August 26, the Japanese government invested a total of about ¥15.4 trillion in FX interventions, setting a new high for intervention amounts.

FX interventions require Japan to sell foreign currency and buy yen. Because Japan holds large amounts of U.S. Treasuries in its foreign reserves, the market closely watches whether Japan will sell Treasury or other dollar assets to provide the 'silver bullet' for the intervention.

However, it should be noted that the TIC report records changes in net holdings, which include both actual trades and changes in bond valuations. Therefore, investors cannot rely solely on this report to determine how many U.S. Treasuries Japan sold to intervene in the market.

items.title: Fed 3年來首度升息後 市場押注再升息 加幣重貶至6週低點
items.title_en: After the Fed's First Rate Hike in Three Years, Markets Bet on Further Hikes as the Canadian Dollar Slumps to a Six‑Week Low
paras: 加拿大貨幣周三(16日)走弱，兌美元跌至6週低點，主要受到美國聯準會(Fed)宣布3年來首度升息，以及市場進一步押注未來數月仍可能持續升息的影響。加幣盤中一度觸及1美元兌1.3994加幣，為8月7日以來最低，尾盤報1.3990加幣，單日下跌0.5%，相當於1加幣兌71.48美分。
聯準會周三將基準利率上調25個基點至3.75%-4.00%，並釋放未來數月可能進一步提高借貸成本的訊號，目標是讓通膨更及時回到2%的政策目標。聯準會最新聲明指出，美國經濟活動仍以穩健速度擴張，生產力成長強勁、資本投資保持韌性，但通膨仍處於偏高水準，因此本次升息有助於加快通膨回落至2%。
市場對後續升息的預期同步升溫，美元因此走強，進一步壓抑加幣表現。Corpay(CPAY-US)首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，美元兌主要貨幣持續走高，美國公債殖利率也在對貨幣政策敏感的期限段上升，投資人正逐步提高對聯準會12月再次升息的預期。
聯準會最新經濟預測也顯示，18名政策制定者中有16人預期今年底前至少還會升息1次，若按照多數官員預測，聯邦基金利率年底可能升至4.00%-4.25%區間，顯示聯準會在通膨仍偏高的情況下，並未排除持續緊縮的可能性。
加拿大方面，市場同樣開始評估加拿大央行後續升息可能性。互換市場數據顯示，加拿大央行未來幾個月也可能收緊貨幣政策。加拿大央行9月2日維持隔夜利率目標在2.25%，當時已指出通膨上行風險升高，尤其高油價持續時間越長，能源成本向其他商品與服務價格擴散的風險越大。
加拿大央行9月會議紀要顯示，決策官員認為通膨短期內可能維持在較高水準。央行9月2日公布的政策聲明則指出，加拿大第2季GDP年化成長率達3.3%，經濟活動普遍改善，消費、住宅市場、出口及企業投資均有所回升；7月失業率則降至6.4%。不過，央行同時表示，美國新關稅及加拿大反制措施仍使經濟前景存在高度不確定性。
能源價格走勢也對加幣構成壓力。原油是加拿大主要出口商品之一，國際油價周三下跌，市場因沙烏地阿拉伯透過阿曼提供額外原油貨載的消息，降低對中東供應中斷規模的疑慮。美國原油期貨周三結算下跌3.2%，報每桶102.43美元。
油價下跌對加幣尤其受到關注，因能源出口是加拿大經濟與貿易的重要組成部分。當原油價格回落時，加拿大出口收入及商品貨幣相關資金流可能受到影響，加上美元受到美國升息預期支撐，雙重因素使加幣承受壓力。
加拿大國內經濟數據亦未提供加幣太多支撐。加拿大8月房屋開工率折合年率為229,046戶，低於7月經修正後的229,360戶，也低於經濟學家預期的240,000戶，顯示住宅建設活動略有降溫。
加拿大公債殖利率則呈現曲線趨平走勢。2年期殖利率上升2個基點至3.376%，10年期殖利率則下滑1.1個基點至3.941%，延續周一觸及接近3年高點3.987%後的回落走勢。
在美加利差重新受到市場關注之際，美元走強也不只壓抑加幣。聯準會升息後，美元指數周三上漲0.3%，報99.961，創近5週新高；歐元下跌0.3%至1.1502美元，英鎊下跌0.5%至1.34155美元，美元兌日元則上升0.3%至155.49日元。
加拿大央行目前的政策利率仍明顯低於聯準會，但若美國持續升息、加拿大央行維持利率不變，美加利率差可能進一步擴大，成為支撐美元兌加幣匯率的重要因素。不過，加拿大央行9月政策聲明也指出，將持續評估經濟復甦的可持續性及通膨前景，並準備在必要時調整貨幣政策。
因此，近期加幣走勢將同時受到聯準會後續利率路徑、加拿大央行政策方向、美元表現及原油價格影響。市場目前尤其關注聯準會是否在今年底前再度升息，以及加拿大通膨與經濟數據是否足以促使加拿大央行改變目前的政策立場。
paras_en: The Canadian dollar weakened on Wednesday, falling to a six‑week low against the U.S. dollar, mainly due to the Federal Reserve’s announcement of its first rate hike in three years and markets further betting that rate increases could continue in the coming months. The CAD briefly touched 1.3994 per U.S. dollar, the lowest since August 7, and closed at 1.3990, down 0.5% for the day, equivalent to 1 CAD = 71.48 US cents.

The Fed raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points on Wednesday to a target range of 3.75%‑4.00% and signaled that borrowing costs could rise further in the months ahead, aiming to bring inflation back to the 2% policy goal more promptly. The Fed’s latest statement noted that U.S. economic activity is still expanding at a solid pace, productivity growth is strong, capital investment remains resilient, but inflation remains elevated, so this hike helps accelerate inflation’s return to 2%.

Market expectations for additional hikes warmed up in tandem, strengthening the dollar and further suppressing the Canadian dollar. Corpay (CPAY‑US) chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said the dollar’s rise against major currencies continues, U.S. Treasury yields are also climbing in policy‑sensitive maturities, and investors are gradually raising expectations for another Fed hike in December.

The Fed’s latest economic forecasts also show that 16 of 18 policymakers expect at least one more hike before the end of the year; based on the majority view, the federal funds rate could end the year in the 4.00%‑4.25% range, indicating the Fed has not ruled out continued tightening while inflation stays above target.

In Canada, the market likewise began assessing the possibility of further Bank of Canada hikes. Swap‑market data suggest the BoC may tighten policy over the next few months. The BoC kept its overnight rate target at 2.25% on September 2, noting heightened upside inflation risks, especially the longer high oil prices persist, the greater the risk that energy costs will spill over into other goods and services.

BoC September meeting minutes showed policymakers believe inflation could remain at a relatively high level in the short term. The policy statement released on September 2 said Canada’s Q2 GDP grew at an annualized 3.3%, economic activity broadly improved, and consumption, housing, exports and business investment all rebounded; July unemployment fell to 6.4%. However, the bank also said new U.S. tariffs and Canadian counter‑measures keep the economic outlook highly uncertain.

Energy‑price trends also put pressure on the CAD. Crude oil is one of Canada’s main export commodities, and international oil prices fell on Wednesday as the market eased concerns over Middle‑East supply disruptions after Saudi Arabia offered additional cargoes via Oman. U.S. crude futures settled down 3.2% at $102.43 a barrel.

The oil‑price drop is especially watched for the CAD because energy exports are a key component of Canada’s economy and trade. When oil prices retreat, Canadian export revenues and commodity‑currency flows may be affected, and with the dollar supported by U.S. rate‑hike expectations, the dual factors pressure the CAD.

Domestic Canadian economic data also gave little support to the CAD. August housing starts were 229,046 units annualized, below July’s revised 229,360 and below economists’ forecast of 240,000, indicating a slight cooling in residential construction activity.

Canadian government‑bond yields showed a flattening curve. The two‑year yield rose 2 basis points to 3.376%, while the ten‑year slipped 1.1 basis points to 3.941%, continuing the pull‑back after hitting near a three‑year high of 3.987% on Monday.

As the Canada‑U.S. rate differential again draws market attention, a stronger dollar also suppresses the CAD. After the Fed hike, the dollar index rose 0.3% on Wednesday to 99.961, a near‑five‑week high; the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1502, the pound slipped 0.5% to $1.34155, and the dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to ¥155.49.

The BoC’s policy rate remains clearly below the Fed’s, but if the U.S. continues hiking while the BoC holds rates steady, the Canada‑U.S. rate gap could widen further, becoming a key driver of the USD/CAD exchange rate. However, the BoC’s September policy statement also said it will keep assessing the sustainability of the economic recovery and the inflation outlook, and is ready to adjust policy if needed.

Therefore, the CAD’s near‑term trajectory will be shaped by the Fed’s future rate path, BoC policy direction, dollar performance and oil prices. Markets are especially focused on whether the Fed will hike again before year‑end and whether Canadian inflation and economic data are strong enough to prompt the BoC to change its current stance.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 Fed升息1碼
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Strengthens as Fed Raises Rates by One Quarter Point
paras: 美元周三(16日)進一步走高，美國聯準會(Fed)三年多來首次升息，美元連續第六個交易日上漲。另一方面，英鎊在英國政府數據顯示8月消費者通膨加速後走弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.4%，報99.89。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三如市場普遍預期升息，這也是自2023年7月以來首次收緊貨幣政策。同時，聯準會最新的「點陣圖」顯示，官員預測今年還會再升息一次。
FOMC一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。
在周三聯準會公布利率決策之前，市場對升息的預期一直穩步升溫，部分原因是美國經濟數據顯示經濟成長具韌性、勞動市場強勁，以及通膨維持偏高。
聯準會偏好的最新通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——顯示年增3.7%，遠高於聯準會長期設定的2%目標。事實上，PCE已經連續65個月高於2%。
與經濟數據，以及中東衝突擴大導致油價再次上漲相比，美國債券市場可能是推升升息預期的最大因素。
自聯準會7月會議左右開始，美國債券市場便陷入持續不斷的拋售，尤其是較長天期債券，導致美國公債殖利率飆升至多年甚至數十年來的高點。
這波債券拋售起初是因為三位地區聯準銀行總裁不同意FOMC在7月維持利率不變的決定，反而主張升息，這顯示固定收益市場的交易員對聯準會打擊通膨的努力並不滿意。
到了8月，隨著油價飆升、市場擔心數十億美元資金持續投入AI基礎建設，以及美國財政債務不斷膨脹，債券拋售進一步加劇。
美國10年期公債殖利率周二創下2007年4月以來最高水準。10年期公債殖利率是房貸、企業債務及學生貸款等各類借貸的重要基準，30年期公債殖利率也創下超過24年來的新高。
現在外匯市場關注的問題是：今天市場預期中的升息究竟會是「升一次就結束」，還是會成為新一輪升息周期的開始？
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場參與者預期今年至少還會有一次25個基點的升息。
在這樣的背景下，市場將密切關注聯準會最新發布的經濟預測摘要，以了解未來貨幣政策的方向。
同時，華許和聯準會也面臨要求降息的政治壓力，其中最明顯的來自美國總統川普。
Wilsey Asset Management投資長Brent Wilsey表示，「聯準會正面臨來自債券市場的升息壓力，因為一般而言，聯邦資金利率不會長期維持在遠低於債券殖利率的水準。」
他補充，「如果聯準會周三決定維持利率不變，可能會讓市場感到意外……而市場通常不會很好的接受意外情況。這也可能損害聯準會的公信力，並重新引發外界對聯準會是否屈服於政治壓力、選擇維持利率不變的疑慮。」
英國年度CPI增幅創3月以來最高
英鎊周三成為市場焦點，下跌0.2%，至1英鎊兌1.3447美元。
稍早，英國國家統計局公布，英國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.1%，高於7月的2.9%，也是自3月的3.3%以來最高。
以月增率來看，8月CPI上升0.5%，高於7月的0.3%。交通價格，尤其是汽油等車用燃料價格，對年度CPI增幅的推升幅度最大，反映出中東持續衝突導致全球油價飆升。比較正面的訊號是，英國8月核心CPI年增2.6%，與7月持平。
這份通膨數據公布的隔天，就是英格蘭銀行(BoE)公布利率決策的日子。市場普遍預期英格蘭銀行將維持利率不變。
不過，利率交換市場交易員目前認為，英格蘭銀行進行25個基點升息的機率約為三分之一。此外，市場也大致已消化今年年底前還會再升息一次的預期。
德意志銀行首席英國經濟學家Sanjay Raja表示，「對英格蘭銀行而言，要讓通膨維持在2%的工作已經變得更加困難。我們自己的預測顯示，CPI很可能在年初年末交界附近接近4%。」
「利率可能已經具有抑制效果，但貨幣政策委員會面臨的關鍵政策問題仍是：目前的限制程度是否足夠？風險管理方面的考量已經變得更加重要，而近期升息的可能性也有所提高。」

paras_en: The dollar rose further on Wednesday (the 16th), marking the Fed's first rate hike in over three years, and the dollar has been up for six consecutive trading days. Meanwhile, the pound weakened after UK government data showed accelerated consumer inflation in August.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.4% to 99.89.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) raised rates on Wednesday as broadly expected, marking the first tightening of monetary policy since July 2023. At the same time, the Fed's latest dot‑plot shows officials anticipate one more hike this year.
The FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%.

Before the Fed announced its rate decision on Wednesday, market expectations for a hike had been steadily warming, partly because U.S. economic data showed resilient growth, a strong labor market, and inflation remaining elevated.

The Fed's preferred inflation gauge, the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, showed a 3.7% year‑over‑year increase, far above the Fed’s long‑run 2% target. In fact, PCE has been above 2% for 65 consecutive months.
Compared with the economic data and the renewed Middle‑East conflict that pushed oil prices higher again, the U.S. bond market may be the biggest driver of the rising rate‑hike expectations.

Since around the Fed’s July meeting, the U.S. bond market has been in a relentless sell‑off, especially in longer‑dated securities, sending Treasury yields soaring to multi‑year, even multi‑decade highs.

The bond sell‑off initially stemmed from three regional Fed bank presidents who disagreed with the FOMC’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and instead advocated a hike, indicating fixed‑income traders were dissatisfied with the Fed’s inflation‑fighting efforts.
By August, the sell‑off intensified as oil prices surged, markets worried about billions of dollars flowing into AI infrastructure, and U.S. fiscal debt continued to expand.

U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields hit their highest level since April 2007 on Tuesday. The 10‑year yield is a key benchmark for mortgages, corporate debt and student loans, while the 30‑year yield also reached a 24‑year high.
The forex market now focuses on whether today’s anticipated hike will be a one‑off “stop‑after‑one” move or the start of a new tightening cycle.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, market participants expect at least one more 25‑basis‑point hike this year.
Against this backdrop, markets will watch the Fed’s latest Summary of Economic Projections closely to gauge the future direction of policy.
At the same time, both the Fed and Treasury face political pressure to cut rates, most visibly from President Trump.

Wilsey Asset Management’s chief investment officer Brent Wilsey said, “The Fed is under rate‑hike pressure from the bond market because, generally, the federal funds rate does not stay far below bond yields for long.”

He added, “If the Fed decided to keep rates unchanged on Wednesday, it could surprise the market… and markets typically do not react well to surprises. That could also damage the Fed’s credibility and revive doubts about whether the Fed is yielding to political pressure by holding rates steady.”
UK annual CPI rise hits highest level since March
The pound became a market focus on Wednesday, slipping 0.2% to $1.3447 per pound.
Earlier, the UK Office for National Statistics reported that August CPI rose 3.1% year‑over‑year, up from 2.9% in July and the highest since March’s 3.3%.

On a monthly basis, August CPI rose 0.5%, above July’s 0.3%. Transport prices, especially gasoline and other vehicle fuels, drove the biggest annual CPI increase, reflecting global oil price spikes from the ongoing Middle‑East conflict. A brighter note is that core CPI for August was up 2.6% year‑over‑year, unchanged from July.
The day after this inflation data is the Bank of England’s rate‑decision day. Markets broadly expect the BoE to keep rates unchanged.
However, rate‑swap traders currently see about a one‑in‑three chance of a 25‑basis‑point BoE hike. The market has also largely priced in another hike before year‑end.

Deutsche Bank’s chief UK economist Sanjay Raja said, “For the BoE, keeping inflation at 2% is becoming increasingly difficult. Our own forecasts suggest CPI could be near 4% around the turn of the year.”

“Rates may already be having a restraining effect, but the key policy question for the Monetary Policy Committee remains: is the current level of restriction sufficient? Risk‑management considerations are becoming more important, and the likelihood of a near‑term hike has risen.”

items.title: 日本超低利率時代加速落幕！日銀周五料升息至31年高點
items.title_en: Japan's Ultra‑Low‑Rate Era Accelerates Its End as BOJ Likely to Raise Rates to 31‑Year High on Friday
paras: 日本央行(BOJ)預料將在周五(18日)結束為期兩天的貨幣政策會議後升息1碼，把政策利率由1%提高至1.25%，創31年來最高水準。這將是BOJ相隔3個月再度升息，反映油價、日元疲弱及進口成本上升帶來的通膨壓力，也象徵日本進一步告別延續數十年的超低利率環境。
市場已幾乎完全反映本周升息，投資人更關注BOJ總裁植田和男會如何描述後續政策，以及是否暗示升息速度加快。若措辭過於鴿派，日元可能再度走貶並推高進口物價；但若釋出太強烈的鷹派訊號，又可能加劇日本公債賣壓。

升息1碼幾成定局 89%受訪者認同

《CNBC》於9月9日至14日訪問18名經濟學家及分析師，其中約89%預期BOJ本周將升息1碼至1.25%，主要理由包括通膨上升、薪資成長及美國政府施壓。
這將是BOJ自2024年3月啟動政策正常化以來，首度縮短先前約6個月一次的升息間隔。BOJ今年6月曾升息，7月則按兵不動，但當時已警告，燃料成本飆升、日元疲弱推高進口價格，以及人工智慧(AI)需求強勁，都可能使通膨超出預期。
日本7月整體通膨率升至1.9%，創今年最高，主要受到伊朗戰事推升能源價格影響；同月實質薪資年增2.4%，連續第7個月成長。植田和男本月稍早表示，日本基礎通膨已「相當接近」2%目標，BOJ必須特別留意物價上行風險。
《路透》調查顯示，分析師普遍預期BOJ本月將利率升至1.25%，明年3月底前再升至1.5%，並於2027年第二季達到1.75%。多數受訪者認為，這一輪升息周期的終點利率至少為1.75%。
BOJ決策委員Toichiro Asada曾在6月反對升息，分析師認為他本周可能再度投下反對票。《CNBC》調查中，約三分之一受訪者認為Toichiro Asada及Ayano Sato最可能反對升息，兩人均被視為支持通膨及寬鬆政策的「再通膨派」。
市場仍存在少數不同看法。Monex Group專家主管Jesper Koll預期，BOJ可能一次升息2碼，隨後停止行動；瑞士百達銀行(UBP)亞洲資深經濟學家Carlos Casanova則認為，本周應暫時按兵不動，因現有數據仍不足以證明日本貨幣政策需要加速轉向。

說得太鴿日元恐跌 太鷹債市又承壓

利率若升至1.25%，將進入BOJ估算的1.1%至2.5%名目中性利率區間。所謂中性利率，是既不刺激也不抑制經濟成長的利率水準，這將使市場更加關注BOJ最終能把利率升到多高。
植田和男過去表示，BOJ並未預設升息終點，但熟悉央行想法的知情人士透露，多名官員相信，在政策真正達到中性水準前，仍有數次升息空間。立場偏鷹的決策委員田村直樹便認為，日本中性利率約為2%。
植田和男在會後記者會上將面臨艱難的溝通考驗。BOJ不希望提前承諾很快再次升息，但若重複過去偏鴿派的「視數據而定」說法，可能引發日元新一輪賣壓，使進口物價及通膨進一步升高。
另一方面，日本公債市場已因財政前景疑慮遭到拋售，殖利率攀升至30多年高點。若植田和男過度強調持續升息，可能推高市場對終點利率的預期，加劇公債跌勢。
三井住友信託資產管理資深策略師Katsutoshi Inadome表示，市場對鷹派訊號的影響看法分歧。部分投資人認為，更堅定的抗通膨立場能化解BOJ落後情勢的疑慮，反而有助壓低長期殖利率；另一派則認為，鷹派訊號將推升終點利率預期，使殖利率進一步走高。在市場反應難以預料下，BOJ最安全的策略可能是保持模糊。

美國施壓升息 日元短線料難突破150

美國政府也持續敦促日本採取更強硬的貨幣及匯率政策。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本月稍早在二十國集團(G20)財長及央行總裁會議期間，要求植田和男採取「果斷的市場及貨幣措施」。
美方希望日元走強，原因是日元持續疲弱可能迫使日本出售包括美債在內的美元資產，以取得干預匯市所需資金，進一步推高美債殖利率。美日兩國7月底更曾罕見聯手干預匯市，以支撐日元。
野村綜合研究所執行經濟學家、前BOJ決策委員木內登英(Takahide Kiuchi)表示，川普政府實際上已阻止高市早苗政府干預BOJ升息，使央行如今能更自由地推動利率正常化。
高市早苗偏好寬鬆貨幣政策及擴張性財政措施，仍使BOJ決策更加複雜。國際貨幣基金(IMF)總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)日前警告，在政府債務高企及財政主導疑慮升溫下，通膨預期可能上揚，央行面對未來衝擊時必須強力回應，才能維護獨立性與公信力。
匯市方面，《CNBC》調查中約61%受訪者預期，未來一個月美元兌日元將落在155至160日元區間。Lombard Odier資深總體策略師Homin Lee認為，BOJ轉向鷹派將有助避免日元貶破160，但要升破150仍不容易，因日本政府及企業可能反對日元以「不適當」的速度快速升值。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) expects to raise its policy rate by one basis point after concluding a two‑day monetary policy meeting on Friday (the 18th), moving the rate from 1.0% to 1.25%, the highest level in 31 years. This would be the first hike in three months, reflecting inflation pressure from higher oil prices, a weak yen and rising import costs, and signalling Japan’s further departure from decades of ultra‑low rates.

Markets have already priced in the rate hike almost completely; investors are now watching how BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda will describe the policy outlook and whether he hints at a faster pace of tightening. If his language is too dovish, the yen could weaken further and push up import prices; if he signals overly hawkish a stance, it could intensify selling pressure on Japanese government bonds.

A CNBC poll of 18 economists and analysts conducted from Sept. 9‑14 found about 89% expect the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% this week, citing rising inflation, wage growth and pressure from the U.S. government as the main reasons.

This would be the first time since the BOJ began normalising policy in March 2024 that the roughly six‑month interval between hikes is shortened. The BOJ raised rates in June and held steady in July, but warned then that soaring fuel costs, a weak yen lifting import prices and strong AI demand could push inflation beyond expectations.

Japan’s overall inflation rose to 1.9% in July, the highest this year, driven mainly by higher energy prices after the Iran conflict; real wages grew 2.4% year‑on‑year, marking the seventh consecutive month of growth. Earlier this month Ueda said core inflation was “fairly close” to the 2% target, and the BOJ must watch upside price risks closely.

A Reuters survey shows analysts generally expect the BOJ to lift the rate to 1.25% this month, then to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and to reach 1.75% in the second quarter of 2027. Most respondents see the end‑point of this tightening cycle at least 1.75%.

BOJ policy‑making member Toichiro Asada opposed a hike in June, and analysts think he may cast another dissenting vote this week. In the CNBC poll, about one‑third of respondents said Asada and Ayano Sato are the most likely to oppose a hike, both viewed as “re‑inflation” advocates who support higher inflation and looser policy.

A minority of market voices remain. Jesper Koll, a senior expert at Monex Group, expects the BOJ could raise rates by two basis points in one move and then pause. Carlos Casanova, senior economist for Asia at Swiss bank UBS, argues the BOJ should hold steady this week because current data do not yet justify accelerating the policy shift.

If rates rise to 1.25%, they will fall within the BOJ’s estimated nominal neutral range of 1.1%‑2.5%. A neutral rate is one that neither stimulates nor restrains economic growth, and this will sharpen market focus on how high the BOJ ultimately can push rates.

Ueda has previously said the BOJ does not set a predetermined hike end‑point, but insiders familiar with the central bank say several officials believe there is still room for multiple hikes before policy reaches a truly neutral level. Hawkish policy‑maker Naoki Tamura, for example, estimates Japan’s neutral rate at around 2%.

Ueda will face a tough communication test at the post‑meeting press conference. The BOJ does not want to pre‑commit to another quick hike, yet repeating a dovish “data‑dependent” stance could trigger a fresh wave of yen selling, further lifting import prices and inflation.

Meanwhile, Japan’s sovereign‑bond market has been sold off over fiscal‑outlook concerns, with yields climbing to their highest in more than 30 years. If Ueda over‑emphasises continued tightening, it could raise market expectations for the final rate level and deepen bond price declines.

Katsutoshi Inadome, senior strategist at Mitsui Sumitomo Trust Asset Management, says market views on hawkish signals are split. Some investors think a firmer anti‑inflation stance will allay worries about the BOJ lagging behind and could help lower long‑term yields; others believe hawkish cues will push up expectations for the terminal rate, lifting yields further. With market reaction uncertain, the safest BOJ approach may be to stay ambiguous.

The United States continues to press Japan for tougher monetary and exchange‑rate policies. Earlier this month, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Ueda at the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting to take “decisive market and monetary actions.”

The U.S. wants a stronger yen because a persistently weak yen could force Japan to sell dollar assets, including U.S. Treasuries, to fund currency‑market intervention, which would push U.S. Treasury yields higher. Japan and the U.S. jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market in late July in a rare move to support the yen.

Takahide Kiuchi, chief economist at Nomura Research Institute and former BOJ policy‑making member, says the Trump administration effectively blocked the Kishida government from intervening in BOJ rate hikes, allowing the central bank more freedom to normalise rates.

Kishida’s preference for loose monetary policy and expansionary fiscal measures still complicates BOJ decision‑making. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva recently warned that with soaring government debt and rising fiscal‑dominance concerns, inflation expectations could rise, forcing central banks to respond forcefully to preserve independence and credibility.

In the FX market, about 61% of respondents in the CNBC survey expect the dollar‑yen pair to trade between 155 and 160 yen over the next month. Homin Lee, senior global strategist at Lombard Odier, believes a shift toward hawkish policy at the BOJ will help keep the yen from slipping past 160, but breaking the 150‑yen barrier will remain difficult as the Japanese government and corporations may oppose a rapid, “inappropriate” appreciation.

items.title: 日元讓位 瑞士法郎與瑞典克朗躍升套利交易融資新寵
items.title_en: Yen Steps Aside as Swiss Franc and Swedish Krona Become New Favorites for Arbitrage Financing
paras: 隨著日本央行升息預期增溫及政府進行匯市聯合干預，長期作為全球「套利交易」主要融資貨幣的日元吸引力漸失。市場投資人開始將目光轉向瑞士法郎、瑞典克朗與加拿大元等低殖利率貨幣，尋找取代日元的新融資管道。
Russell Investments全球固定收益與外匯解決方案策略主管 Van Luu 表示：「投資人仍希望參與套利交易，但借入端的選擇成為關鍵問題。」
他指出，日本今年兩度干預匯市並引導升息，顯示當局偏好強勢日元。相反地，瑞士預計將零利率維持至2027年底，並樂見瑞郎走軟以支持出口。因此，從貨幣政策分歧與匯率角度來看，瑞士法郎已成為最具吸引力的融資貨幣。
績效表現也印證了此轉變：自7月以來，以日元融資購買澳元的套利交易虧損了1.3%，遠不及今年上半年的9%獲利；反觀以瑞郎融資的套利策略，在2026年整體回報率高達14%。
倫敦 TJM 公司外匯銷售與交易董事總經理 Neil Jones 觀察指出：「拋售瑞郎並買進日元，正是融資貨幣發生長期轉移的具體體現。」
此外，摩根大通全球外匯策略共同主管 Meera Chandan 則推薦瑞典克朗與加拿大元，做為借入標的。她分析，與澳洲或新興市場等高殖利率貨幣相比，克朗與加元存在顯著的殖利率劣勢，且對經濟周期高度敏感，因此建議可相對於受美國聯準會升息預期支撐的美元進行拋售。
然而，這類替代策略仍存有風險，日元仍具備遠高於其他同業貨幣的市場流動性。安聯環球投資(AllianzGI)多重資產策略投資長 Greg Hirt 提醒，瑞郎作為傳統避險資產，在面臨地緣政治或歐洲政治風險(如法國與義大利選舉)時易劇烈升值。
他指出，在歐洲風險方面，瑞郎是相當標準的避險貨幣。如果法國確實出現問題，瑞郎將大幅走強。在套利交易極需匯率穩定的前提下，瑞郎的避險屬性恐增添市場波動風險。
paras_en: As expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes warm and the government conducts joint FX market intervention, the yen—long a primary financing currency for global arbitrage trades—has been losing its appeal. Market participants are turning to low‑yield currencies such as the Swiss franc, Swedish krona and Canadian dollar to find new financing avenues to replace the yen.
Russell Investments’ Global Fixed Income and FX Solutions Strategy head Van Luu said, “Investors still want to engage in arbitrage, but the choice of borrowing currency has become the key issue.”

He noted that Japan intervened in the FX market twice this year and signaled rate hikes, showing authorities favour a strong yen. In contrast, Switzerland is expected to keep rates at zero until the end of 2027 and welcomes a weaker franc to support exports. Thus, from a monetary‑policy divergence and exchange‑rate perspective, the Swiss franc has become the most attractive financing currency.

Performance data confirm the shift: since July, arbitrage trades that financed Australian‑dollar purchases with yen have lost 1.3%, far below the 9% profit recorded in the first half of the year; by contrast, franc‑financed arbitrage strategies posted an overall 2026 return of 14%.
London‑based TJM’s FX Sales and Trading Managing Director Neil Jones observed, “Selling the franc and buying the yen is a concrete illustration of the long‑term migration of financing currencies.”

Additionally, JPMorgan’s Global FX Strategy co‑head Meera Chandan recommends the Swedish krona and Canadian dollar as borrowing targets. She argues that, compared with high‑yielding currencies such as the Australian dollar or emerging‑market units, the krona and the loonie have a pronounced yield disadvantage and are highly sensitive to economic cycles, so she suggests selling them relative to a dollar that is supported by expectations of further Fed hikes.

However, these alternative strategies still carry risk, as the yen retains far higher market liquidity than other peer currencies. AllianzGI multi‑asset strategy chief Greg Hirt warned that the franc, as a traditional safe‑haven asset, can appreciate sharply during geopolitical or European political stress (e.g., French or Italian elections).

He added that the franc is a textbook safe‑haven currency in European‑risk scenarios. If France were to encounter serious problems, the franc would rally strongly. In arbitrage trades that depend on exchange‑rate stability, the franc’s safe‑haven trait could actually add market‑volatility risk.

items.title: 〈台幣〉Fed升息預期升溫！連5貶探近1月新低 面臨32元保衛戰
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up! Five Consecutive Declines, Near One‑Month Low, Facing a NT$32 Defence Battle
paras: 新台幣兌美元今(16)日走勢震盪，市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期升溫，加上國際油價續揚推升通膨疑慮、美債殖利率突破5%，主要亞幣持續承壓，新台幣早盤一度貶破31.9元關卡，面臨 32 元保衛戰，隨後雖受台股反彈帶動強勢翻紅，但終場仍敵不過美元買盤，收在31.888元，貶值4分，呈現連 5 貶，探近 1 個月新低，台北外匯市場成交金額縮至 13.94 億美元，市場轉趨觀望。
新台幣今日以31.87元開出後，早盤隨亞幣走低，最低下探至31.932元。不過上午10點過後，隨著台股拉升，匯價出現急拉並轉升，高點一度觸及31.79元，高低波動逾1角，終場則再度翻貶以31.888元作收。前一交易日新台幣在美元強勢與外資匯出下，盤中曾重貶逾2角，尾盤經央行進場調節後收在31.688元，今日則呈現先升後貶的洗盤格局。
根據央行統計主要貨幣今日表現，美元指數微幅拉回0.03%，亞幣普遍承壓，其中以韓元重挫0.51%最為劇烈，新台幣貶值0.13%，日元及新加坡幣分別走貶0.06%與0.05%；人民幣則展現韌性，逆勢升值0.10%。
台積電今天盤中強勢填息，台股一度上漲超過 560 點，不過，適逢台指期結算，買盤相對謹慎，加權指數終場收在 45848.9 點，上漲337.41點。外資賣超 179.8 億元，投信買超 95.74 億元，自營商則賣超 129.74 億元。
匯銀人士分析，各大研究機構已針對Fed政策決策進行沙盤推演，市場已大致消化升息1碼的預期，因此若最終結果符合預期，美元不致出現劇烈劇動。然而，市場焦點將轉向Fed會後聲明與主席談話是否釋出鷹派訊號，若政策態度偏鷹，恐引發重啟升息循環的討論並觸發市場重新定價，屆時美債殖利率與美元將再獲得支撐，亞幣勢必面臨更沉重的貶值壓力。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar fluctuated today (the 16th), as market expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes intensified, international oil prices kept rising fueling inflation concerns, and US Treasury yields broke the 5% mark, keeping major Asian currencies under pressure. The NT$ briefly slipped past the NT$31.9 barrier in early trading, prompting a defence of the NT$32 level; although it later rallied strongly on the back of a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, it ultimately could not withstand dollar buying pressure and closed at NT$31.888, down 0.04, marking a fifth straight decline and approaching a one‑month low. Turnover in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$1.394 billion as market sentiment turned cautious.

After opening at NT$31.87, the NT$ fell with other Asian currencies in early trading, reaching a low of NT$31.932. However, after 10 a.m., as the Taiwan stock market rose, the exchange rate surged sharply and turned higher, briefly touching NT$31.79, with a swing of more than 0.1 NT$ during the session. It ended the day back in decline at NT$31.888. On the previous trading day, the NT$ had been heavily pressured by a strong dollar and foreign‑capital outflows, sinking more than 0.2 NT$ intraday before the central bank intervened at the close to bring it to NT$31.688. Today’s pattern was a wash‑trade of an initial rise followed by a decline.

According to the central bank’s statistics on major currencies today, the US Dollar Index slipped marginally by 0.03%. Asian currencies were broadly under pressure, with the Korean won plunging the most at –0.51%. The New Taiwan dollar depreciated 0.13%, while the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar fell 0.06% and 0.05% respectively; the Chinese renminbi showed resilience, appreciating 0.10% against the dollar.

TSMC posted strong earnings during the session, lifting the Taiwan stock index by more than 560 points. However, with the Taiwan futures contract settlement occurring, buying was relatively cautious and the weighted index closed at 45,848.9 points, up 337.41 points. Foreign investors sold NT$17.98 billion, investment trusts bought NT$9.574 billion, and proprietary traders sold NT$12.974 billion.

Analysts from foreign exchange banks said that major research institutions have already run scenario analyses on Fed policy decisions, and the market has largely priced in a one‑point rate hike. Therefore, if the final outcome matches expectations, the dollar is unlikely to experience extreme volatility. The market’s focus will shift to the Fed’s post‑meeting statement and the chair’s remarks to see if any hawkish signals are conveyed. If policy stance leans hawkish, it could reignite discussions of restarting the rate‑hike cycle and trigger a market repricing, which would again support US Treasury yields and the dollar, putting even heavier depreciation pressure on Asian currencies.

items.title: Fed升息美元會大漲？歷史數據：6次升息週期有一半沒走強
items.title_en: Will the Fed's Rate Hike Trigger a Big Dollar Rally? Historical Data Shows Only Half of Six Hike Cycles Saw a Strong Dollar
paras: 與聯準會(Fed)會議日期掛鉤的利率互換合約顯示，交易員認為本周升息幾乎是板上釘釘。不過，外匯市場更關心的是，聯準會重新啟動升息後，美元指數是否會迎來新一波升值行情。
利率互換合約顯示，交易員認為聯準會此次將利率從目前的3.5%，上調25個基點至3.75%的機率約94%。
隨著9月升息預期快速升溫並逐漸被市場消化，美元指數過去一周明顯走高，最近匯價在99.70附近，再度逼近100大關。
嘉盛集團在最新報告中指出，市場目前普遍認為，聯準會此次行動不會只是一次性的利率調整，而可能代表新一輪實質緊縮週期的開始。這與今年稍早市場預期聯準會可能多次降息的情況形成明顯反轉。
然而，歷史經驗顯示，聯準會升息並不一定會直接推動美元走強。雖然短期利率可能明顯上升，但首次升息後美元走勢仍存在高度不確定性。
從降息預期轉向升息週期
嘉盛集團指出，在聯準會9月聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前，市場對升息的定價已超過90%，幾乎意味著升息已成定局。若聯準會意外維持利率不變，市場可能重新評估其政策可信度，並可能引發美元及長天期美債殖利率劇烈波動
市場目前也認為，此次升息不太可能像1997年一樣僅是單次調整。在美伊戰爭爆發前，市場原本仍預期聯準會今年可能多次降息，但隨後預期方向完全逆轉，目前市場已開始反映未來多次升息可能性，截至明年6月的殖利率曲線甚至顯示，市場預期總計可能升息四次。
若這項預期成真，將代表聯準會政策方向完全逆轉，不僅結束前一階段寬鬆政策，最終利率高度甚至可能超越市場原先預期。
六次升息週期 美元未必同步上漲
為觀察升息對市場的影響，嘉盛集團回顧自1994年以來，首次升息發生在前一次降息至少六個月後的案例，共篩選出1994年、1997年、1999年、2004年、2015年與2022年六個升息週期。
分析顯示，除了1997年聯準會僅進行一次25個基點升息外，其餘週期均代表更廣泛的升息循環啟動。
從短期利率來看，2年期美債殖利率通常會提前反映政策轉向。嘉盛集團指出，在上述六個週期中，首次升息時的2年期美債殖利率都高於三個月前水準，顯示市場通常會在聯準會正式升息前，提前消化緊縮預期。
此次市場也呈現類似情況，隨著升息預期升溫，2年期美債殖利率持續走高。
不過，首次升息後，2年期美債殖利率走勢則有所分歧。在較大規模緊縮週期中，例如1994年、2004年與2022年，殖利率隨著聯準會持續升息而進一步攀升。
美元與升息關聯並非固定
相較於短期債券殖利率，美元走勢更難預測。嘉盛集團指出，雖然過往緊縮週期前夕，美元通常會跟隨短期殖利率上升，但歷史數據顯示，即使短期利率持續攀升，美元指數仍可能下跌，代表升息與美元升值之間並不存在必然關係。
其中，1994年與1999年兩個升息週期，被嘉盛集團認為與當前市場環境更具可比性。當時聯準會都是在利率接近中性水準後開始收緊政策，與2004年、2015年及2022年面臨緊急升息壓力的環境有所不同。
在1994年與1999年週期中，雖然2年期美債殖利率持續走高，但美元指數初期卻呈現相反走勢。尤其1994年，即使聯準會後續展開激進緊縮，美元仍明顯走弱，顯示單靠升息不足以支撐美元行情。
1999年的情況也受到市場關注，因為當時聯準會是在經歷「保險性降息」後重新轉向緊縮，與目前市場從寬鬆預期轉向升息預期的背景有一定相似性。
此外，當時網路科技投資浪潮興起，如今則是AI投資熱潮推動企業資本支出，兩者均處於重大科技轉型階段。
美元短線仍受利率連動影響
嘉盛集團指出，目前美國短債殖利率與美元指數之間存在異常強烈的正相關關係。兩者4週、8週及12週相關係數均約在+0.78至+0.79，其中8週相關係數已位於1992年以來歷史讀數第94百分位附近，12週相關係數更接近第97百分位。
從歷史角度來看，聯準會首次升息後，2年期美債殖利率通常仍可能走高，因此若目前美元與短端利率的高度連動關係持續，美元確實面臨上行壓力。
但嘉盛集團也提醒，市場關聯性會隨時間改變，過去已有多次短端殖利率上升、美元卻未同步走強的案例。因此，即使目前兩者關聯度處於高檔，也不能直接推論聯準會升息必然帶動美元持續升值。
升息類型決定美元方向
國信證券也認為，聯準會升息並不代表美元必然上漲。該機構依據美國經濟、通膨與就業狀況建立抗通膨壓力指數，將升息週期分為抗通膨型升息與預防型升息。
研究顯示，在預防型升息週期中，美元指數平均下跌3.5%；而在抗通膨型升息週期中，美元指數平均上漲6.3%。
這代表若升息主要是因應高通膨壓力，較高利率維持時間與避險需求可能更有利支撐美元；若升息只是政策正常化，美元未必會同步走強。
因此，聯準會啟動升息後，美元是否大幅升值，關鍵並不只在於利率本身，而在於市場如何解讀升息背景、後續政策路徑，以及美國經濟與通膨環境是否持續支撐美元需求。
paras_en: The interest‑rate swap contracts tied to Fed meeting dates show traders view a rate hike this week as almost certain. However, the FX market is more focused on whether the dollar index will start a new appreciation wave once the Fed restarts tightening.
Swap data indicate traders assign about a 94% probability that the Fed will raise rates from the current 3.5% to 3.75% by a 25‑basis‑point move.
As September‑hike expectations heated up and were gradually priced in, the dollar index rose noticeably over the past week, hovering around 99.70 and again edging toward the 100 mark.

IG Group notes that the market now broadly believes this move will not be a one‑off adjustment but could signal the start of a new substantive tightening cycle, a sharp reversal from earlier expectations of multiple rate cuts this year.
Nevertheless, history shows a Fed hike does not automatically strengthen the dollar. While short‑term rates may jump, the dollar’s path after the first hike remains highly uncertain.
From Rate‑Cut Expectations to a Hike Cycle

IG points out that before the September FOMC, the market had priced in a hike at over 90%, essentially making a hike a foregone conclusion. If the Fed were to hold rates unexpectedly, credibility could be reassessed and could spark sharp swings in the dollar and long‑term Treasury yields.

The market also thinks this hike is unlikely to be a single 25‑bp move like in 1997. Before the Iraq war, analysts still expected multiple cuts this year, but that view flipped completely. The curve now reflects the possibility of several hikes, with the yield curve out to June next year implying up to four hikes in total.
If that scenario materialises, it would represent a full reversal of policy, ending the previous accommodative phase and potentially pushing rates higher than originally forecast.
Six Hike Cycles – The Dollar Does Not Always Follow
To gauge the impact of hikes, IG reviewed six cycles since 1994 where the first hike came at least six months after the previous cut: 1994, 1997, 1999, 2004, 2015 and 2022.
The analysis shows that, except for the lone 25‑bp hike in 1997, each cycle marked the start of a broader tightening wave.

From a short‑term rate perspective, the 2‑year Treasury yield usually moves ahead of policy shifts. IG found that in all six cycles, the 2‑year yield was higher at the first hike than three months earlier, indicating markets typically digest tightening expectations before the Fed acts.
The current market mirrors that pattern, with the 2‑year yield climbing as hike expectations rise.
However, after the first hike the 2‑year yield’s trajectory diverges. In larger‑scale cycles such as 1994, 2004 and 2022, yields kept climbing as the Fed kept raising rates.
The Dollar‑Hike Link Is Not Fixed

Compared with short‑term yields, the dollar’s path is harder to predict. IG notes that while the dollar often rose with short‑term yields before past tightening cycles, historical data show the dollar index can still fall even as short‑term rates keep climbing, meaning a hike does not guarantee dollar strength.

IG considers the 1994 and 1999 cycles most comparable to today. In those periods the Fed began tightening only after rates were near neutral, unlike the emergency‑hike environments of 2004, 2015 and 2022.

During the 1994 and 1999 cycles, the 2‑year yield kept rising but the dollar index initially moved in the opposite direction. Notably in 1994, even as the Fed later pursued aggressive tightening, the dollar weakened, showing that hikes alone cannot sustain a dollar rally.

The 1999 episode also draws attention because the Fed shifted back to tightening after a “insurance‑rate cut,” a backdrop somewhat similar to today’s shift from easing expectations to hike expectations.
Moreover, the late‑1990s saw a boom in internet‑tech investment, just as today AI investment is driving corporate cap‑ex – both periods of major tech transformation.
The Dollar Still Tracks Short‑Term Rates in the Near Term

IG points out that currently the correlation between short‑term US yields and the dollar index is unusually strong, with 4‑week, 8‑week and 12‑week coefficients around +0.78 to +0.79. The 8‑week coefficient sits near the 94th percentile of readings since 1992, and the 12‑week near the 97th percentile.
Historically, after a first Fed hike the 2‑year yield often continues to rise, so if the tight link between the dollar and short‑term rates persists, the dollar does face upward pressure.

But IG cautions that these relationships evolve; there have been several instances where short‑term yields rose while the dollar did not keep pace. Hence a high current correlation does not prove that a Fed hike will inevitably lift the dollar.
Hike Type Determines Dollar Direction

Guotai Junan Securities also believes a Fed hike does not guarantee a stronger dollar. The firm builds an anti‑inflation pressure index from US economic, inflation and employment data and classifies hikes into anti‑inflation and preventive types.
Research shows that in preventive‑type cycles the dollar index falls on average 3.5%, whereas in anti‑inflation cycles it rises about 6.3%.

This suggests that if hikes are driven by high inflation pressure, longer‑lasting higher rates and safe‑haven demand may better support the dollar; if hikes are merely policy normalisation, the dollar may not rise in tandem.

Therefore, after the Fed starts tightening, whether the dollar appreciates sharply depends not just on the rate level itself but on how markets interpret the hike’s backdrop, the subsequent policy path, and whether the US economy and inflation continue to underpin dollar demand.
